reviews.author: crivetimihai
reviews.body:
LGTM — clean, minimal fix.

**What was done:**
- Rebased onto `main` (removed merge commits).
- Reviewed the code change and test coverage.

**Review notes:**
- `provider_metadata` is defined in the DB model (`db.py`) as `JSON, default=dict, nullable=False` and is already accepted in both create and update request schemas — the only gap was the GET detail endpoint, which this PR correctly fills.
- The admin-only endpoint (`require_permission("admin.sso_providers:read")`) is the right place to expose this field; no security concerns.
- Test coverage for the new line is confirmed (98% overall on `sso.py`, new line covered).
- Consistent with existing patterns — the list endpoint intentionally returns only basic fields, while the detail GET returns full config.

commits.message:
fix(auth): include provider_metadata in SSO provider detail endpoint

Add provider_metadata field to GET /auth/sso/admin/providers/{provider_id}
response to enable non-destructive updates of SSO provider configuration.

This allows admins to retrieve the complete provider configuration including
role_mappings and other metadata settings, then perform PATCH operations
without losing existing metadata fields.

Closes #3630

Signed-off-by: Abhin Lingamaneni <abhinl99@gmail.com>
